why_v2_cannot_produce_today: Legacy ccxt_ohlcv is a secondary-exchange OHLCV slice (10 dims) derived from a CCXT-style alternative exchange feed.
V2 keeps the native Binance live klines as the canonical OHLCV path; running a parallel CCXT feed has not been approved.

candidates: ccxt against KuCoin (V2 already ingests KuCoin live trades; OHLCV via ccxt can be layered)
ccxt against Binance.us / Bybit / OKX (operator-provided secondary exchange)
CoinAPI OHLCV (V2 already uses CoinAPI for some price data; could be extended)
v2_implementation_outline_if_approved: Extend v2 ingestor registry to publish v2:market:ccxt_ohlcv:{exchange}:{symbol}:{timeframe}.
Add focused projection in full_observation_builder for the 10-dim slice.
Continue treating native Binance v2:market:* as the canonical OHLCV source; ccxt_ohlcv is shadow only.

rationale_for_optionality: ccxt_ohlcv is a secondary alt-exchange OHLCV slice. V2's native Binance OHLCV plus the technical_analysis / binance_klines sub-families already carry the canonical price-history signal for paper inference. The legacy checkpoint is not expected to require ccxt_ohlcv to be filled when native binance_klines is present, but this depends on the operator-provided checkpoint sidecar metadata.
operator_decision_options: APPROVE_CCXT_OHLCV_SHADOW: V2 publishes secondary-exchange OHLCV to v2:market:ccxt_ohlcv:* (shadow only, no live trade impact).
DEFER_CCXT_OHLCV: keep 10 dims explicit-missing as OPERATOR_DECISION_REQUIRED (current default).
EXCLUDE_CCXT_OHLCV: skip permanently; document checkpoint compatibility assumption that native Binance OHLCV is sufficient.
